cases.scenario: A user asks for a recommender build and expects the same level of platform-specific grounding the rest of the pack provides.
pass_if: States that this skill is provisional and its subject matter is outside the pack's source research
Still gives complete, usable guidance rather than deferring
Makes no platform-specific capability claim, and routes delivery questions to the relevant platforms module
Distinguishes clearly between general practice and the pack's researched positions
fail_if: Refuses to help because the skill is provisional
Asserts what a named platform can or cannot do with recommendations

cases.scenario: Cross-sell recommendations are requested for 840 accounts across 14 products, with about 1,900 purchase records.
pass_if: Reports density, interactions per user and interactions per item, and declares collaborative filtering non-viable with the reason
States that a factorisation would return numbers that are noise with a good reconstruction error
Delivers association rules or content-based recommendations instead, with lift, support and confidence
Compares against segment-conditioned popularity, not only global popularity
Does not refuse to produce recommendations
fail_if: Builds matrix factorisation on this data without comment
Refuses to recommend anything because the data is small

cases.scenario: Precision@3 improves from 0.19 to 0.24 against the baseline. A stakeholder wants to report a 26% improvement in recommendation quality to the business.
pass_if: Gives the offline numbers and the relative difference
States that the intervals overlap if they do, and that the improvement is unproven rather than absent
Explains that offline metrics evaluate against behaviour the recommender would have changed, so they penalise discovery
Names the online test as the acceptance criterion and routes to experiment-design-readout
Requires the primary metric to be a business outcome rather than widget click-through
fail_if: Endorses the 26% figure as a business result
Proposes click-through as the primary online metric

cases.scenario: A sales team asks for a next-best-action recommender to tell reps which action to take on each account.
pass_if: Routes the problem to uplift-and-causal-models and explains why: the question is which action changes the outcome
Names the specific difficulties: small action space, slow feedback, confounding by rep discretion
Does not build a propensity ranking and label it a recommendation
Offers what could be delivered immediately while the uplift route is set up
fail_if: Builds a collaborative filter over actions
Presents a propensity ranking as a next-best-action recommender
Refuses without offering an interim answer

cases.scenario: A recommender achieves precision@3 of 0.28 with 6% catalogue coverage and near-zero intra-list diversity.
pass_if: Reports the precision figure and then names the coverage and diversity problem
States plainly that this is a popularity list with extra steps
Explains that precision@k rewards recommending popular items, so a high score is consistent with no personalisation
Recommends the fixes: exploration share, diversity constraint in the re-rank, or accepting the popularity baseline honestly
fail_if: Reports precision@3 as a success with no coverage context
Rejects the recommender without explaining what would fix it

cases.scenario: A recommender has been live for six months. No log of which recommendations were shown exists. An evaluation of its impact is requested.
pass_if: States that impact cannot be evaluated without a record of what was shown to whom, and why
Explains that the current interaction data is contaminated by the recommender's own output
Reports whatever is computable — purchase trends, catalogue coverage over time — and labels it as not attributable to the recommender
Names the specific remedy: start the log now with position and arm, add a randomised holdout, and re-evaluate after a defined period
fail_if: Produces an impact estimate from post-launch purchase data
Compares before and after launch and attributes the difference to the recommender
